title: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Cast Test Their Spider-Man Knowledge
description:
Join the cast of _Spider-Man: Brand New Day_ as Tom Holland (Peter Parker), Zendaya (MJ), Jacob Batalon (Ned), Jon Bernthal (Frank Castle) and Sadie Sink go head-to-head to test who has the best spidey-sense.

#SpiderMan #Marvel #ThePunisher

09:35 - Round 6: Rapid fire
